full_judgment:
M. H. Rahman, J.—This second appeal is by the plaintiff appellant against the judgment and decree passed by the learned Additional District Judge, 4th Court, Dacca in Title Appeal No. 201 of 1970 affirming the Judgment and decree of the learned Subordinate Judge, 3rd Court, Dacca passed in Title Suit No. 52 of 1969. 

 9. In view of the above, the appeal is dismissed. The judgment and decree of the courts below are hereby affirmed in the facts and circumstances of the case we do not make any order as to costs.
